Name: Take-Two Interactive Software Inc
Description: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading American video game holding company headquartered in New York City, recognized for its strong portfolio of highly successful franchises. The company operates two key publishing labels, Rockstar Games and 2K, each supported by a network of internal development studios that drive innovation and creativity in gaming. With a focus on delivering engaging gaming experiences across multiple platforms, Take-Two is well-positioned to capitalize on the growing interactive entertainment market. The company’s strategic investments in its franchises and commitment to quality content development underscore its robust growth potential and competitive edge in the industry.
Address: 110 WEST 44TH STREET, NEW YORK, NY, UNITED STATES, 10036
